about: Renders a row of boxes that take one character each, for a code a person reads from a message. Typing moves to the next box, Backspace moves back, and a pasted code fills every box. The form submits the code as one value.
app: Enter the six figures your authenticator app shows.

attached.about: `attached` joins the boxes into one strip. Adjacent boxes share an edge, and a hovered or focused box is raised above its neighbours.
attached.title: Attached

confirm.about: `onValueComplete` checks the code when the last box fills. A code other than 246810 marks the field invalid and shows its error text, and the next change clears it.
confirm.title: Checked when complete

masked.about: `PinInput.Label` names the group, and a press on it focuses the first box. `mask` hides each character as a password field does.
masked.title: Masked, with a label

sent: Enter the six figures we sent to your phone.

size.about: Each box is a square on the control scale, 32 to 48px from `xs` to `xl`. The gap between boxes reads the gap scale one size smaller.
size.title: Sizes

split.about: `type="alphanumeric"` accepts letters and figures. A dash between the third and fourth boxes splits the code, and `sanitizeValue` drops the dash from a pasted `ABC-123`.
split.title: Split by a dash

states.about: A disabled code dims every box and takes them out of the tab order. A read-only code keeps its value and its tab stop and refuses every change.
states.title: States

status.about: Each status sets the edge and the focus ring of every box, crossed with the three looks.
status.title: Statuses

title: Pin input

variant.about: The theme's three field looks, the same as the input's.
variant.title: Looks

verify.about: Inside a field the group takes its name from the field's label and its description from the helper text, and a press on the label focuses the first box. `otp` asks the browser to offer a code it received by message.
verify.title: One-time code in a field

wrong: That code does not match. Check the app and try again.
